description: Official Raspberry Pi Pico with RP2040 and ROM BOOTSEL recovery

firmware_generation.entry: rp2040-hal entry plus the mandatory 256-byte BOOT2 image
firmware_generation.interrupts: owned by the maintained RP2040 port and selected provider sessions
firmware_generation.dma: shared RP2 completion/cancellation contract with RP2040-local channels and DREQ values
firmware_generation.clock: rp2040-hal board startup owns PLL and timer configuration
firmware_generation.boot: ROM BOOTSEL plus the image's protected BOOT2 stage
